pages.title: Choose Installation Options
texts: Who should this application be installed for?
Please select whether you wish to make this software available to all users or just yourself
There is already a per-user installation.(C:\Kryvex) Will reinstall/upgrade.
buttons: Anyone who uses this computer (&all users)

pages.title: Choose Install Location
texts: Choose the folder in which to install Kryvex.
Setup will install Kryvex in the following folder. To install in a different folder, click Browse and select another folder. Click Install to start the installation.

pages.title: Installing
texts: Please wait while Kryvex is being installed.

pages.title: Completing Kryvex Setup
texts: Kryvex has been installed on your computer. Click Finish to close Setup.
